Description: The system shall ingest cardiac CT image volumes from a specified root directory.
Notes: Root path passed in, ingestion logic centralized

Description: The system shall support volumetric image formats commonly used in public CT datasets.
The system shall fail gracefully with informative errors when required directories or files are missing.
Notes: Errors raised but not yet standardized

Description: The system shall enforce a predefined directory structure for processed datasets.
The system shall validate the presence and non-emptiness of required image subdirectories.
The system shall expose individual samples via a consistent PatientSample interface.
The system shall decouple data ingestion from downstream model code.
The system shall produce deterministic dataset ordering when configured to do so.
PatientSample image_volume shall be a NumPy array.
PatientSample image_volume shall be three-dimensional (z,y,x).
PatientSample image_volume spatial dimensions shall be greater than zero.
PatientSample spacing shall be defined as (z,y,x) with all values > 0
PatientSample shall define a non-empty patient_id.
Annotations may be optional but must be present if required by workflow.
Annotation slice indices shall be valid and within volume bounds.
Vector ROI contours shall be valid (N,2) and within image bounds.
All PatientSample invariants shall be enforced at a single validation boundary.
Dataset validation logic shall be isolated from dataset iteration logic.
Each requirement shall be traceable to at least one implementation artifact.
Each requirement shall be verifiable via tests.
